skills.name: 苦肉
skills.text: 出牌阶段开始时，你可以交给其他角色一张牌，然后失去1点体力（若你交出的牌是【桃】或【酒】，则改为失去2点体力）。当你失去1点体力后，你获得2点护甲。

skills.name: 诈降
skills.text: 锁定技，你于回合内使用的前X张牌无距离和次数限制且不可被响应。摸牌阶段，你多摸X张牌。（X为你已损失体力值）

currentVersusFormal.decision: Use the formal 2023-11-22 wording correction, effective 2023-11-24: 回合内 means the owner actual turn. The current hero/API retain 每个回合; the formal announcement explicitly says this is a wording correction without changing actual effects.

artwork.inspection: Visually inspected the unmodified official 3080 x 4357 JPEG: complete classic Huang Gai portrait with chains and burning arrow. The exact SHA-256 matches the independently fetched current hero source.

engineeringInterpretations: Kurou uses a real owned Hand or Equipment entity and another living recipient, then pays 1 HP loss, or 2 if the frozen effective given card kind is Peach or Alcohol. Native movement children settle before HP loss.
Only direct HpChangeKind.Loss enters the per-point armor trigger, for all causes and turns. Damage HP reduction, recovery and maximum HP changes do not qualify.

Armor cap decision: apply a Kurou-specific maximum of five as the working mobile-product interpretation. The official character text and located primary sources do not specify this cap. This is an explicit product/engineering assumption; generic armor remains unchanged and pre-existing armor above five is never reduced.
ZhaJiang evaluates current lost HP and the prospective whole-actual-turn true Use ordinal. True response Uses count; pure Played does not. No privilege is admitted on another actor actual turn.

Admission, including negative admission, is frozen on the owning declaration/payment and then the native Use frame before material payment. An admitted use retains its distance, quota and response privileges through nested HP or source changes; subsequent uses recompute current eligibility.
Extra normal draw is current lost HP at the native draw query. A later PlayStart gift never retroactively increases a completed draw phase.

Source changes, unusual material conversions, native effect carriers and payment/death boundaries follow explicit repository contracts. They are not presented as a found character-specific official FAQ.

For native departing special equipment and logical Diou carriers, an attempted gift may normalize its real destination to OutsideGame. The exact paid removal retains its following HP-loss step, but no recipient Hand gain is fabricated. This follows the existing physical movement contract, not a verified character-specific mobile ruling.

A prepaid declaration reserves its admitted true-Use position on its unique owning payment through cost children. Later same-actor child Uses cannot borrow that slot; the actual ledger still records genuinely accepted native Uses in their native order. Exact Use/Action/Declaration receipts retire the reservation without a parallel sidecar.

Kurou AI optional admission and entity selection share one real candidate estimate, use the effective given card cost and capped actual armor gain, and exclude active self-lethal payment without pre-crediting rescue. Silver Lion recovery is credited only when public snapshots rule out hidden or potential redirect sources; private foreign skill qualification is never queried.
verificationLimits: No authenticated client or complete manual foreground match was used. No character-specific official armor-cap FAQ was located.

validation.visualInspection: Inspected the unmodified official JPEG and the actual WPF gallery render with the full two-skill mobile edition.
validation.scopeNote: Four new native behavior groups, relevant retained mechanism checks, existing WPF gallery check and measured bounded routine verification. No manual full run or complete foreground match.
coveredBoundaries: True Play-start Hand and Equipment gifts; exact recipient movement before 1/2 native HP loss, per-point armor and decline/stale/forged/private choice boundaries.
Explicit HP loss versus native damage and armor absorption; Kurou-specific cap five without changing generic armor or reducing pre-existing armor above five.
Normal draw queries current lost HP; later gift loss cannot retroactively alter the draw phase.
Whole actual-turn true Use ordinal, ordinary tricks, equipment, native Slash, dynamic loss/recovery and future source loss/regrant restrictions.
Native response Use versus pure Played, real payment once, foreign actual-turn boundaries and cold replay.
Paid gift source loss, genuine dying and Peach rescue return; frozen accepted Use privileges through recovery and source change.
Real Silver Lion material recovery cannot grant a previously negative declaration new privileges; a real Guhuo payment child equipment Use cannot share the mother declaration admitted slot.
Real AI automatic decisions avoid active lethal gifts and use the same candidate estimate as actual selection; hidden foreign skills never enter recovery qualification estimates.
Actual gallery loads the distinct mobile portrait and both complete printed skills without advancing the game.
